text:
bob-customer: Quick sync — we're running an LLM feature for live game matchmaking. Customer asks: can Redwood support BYOK via CloudHSM with keys rotated every 4 hours, and still hit ~<15ms p50 token latency? Also need HSM attestation docs and per-key usage logs for our auditors.
sara-sales: short answer: yes, but tradeoffs. Need to scope POC to validate latency with remote KMS calls vs caching. Also pricing caveat: HSM request egress + wrap/unwarp calls may add per-request line items. :money_with_wings:
max-se: technical detail — we support two recommended modes: (A) server-side key proxy with short TTL caching of unwrapped keys + AEAD wrapping for in-flight, or (B) per-request KMS wrap with aggressive local KV-cache of model KV for minimal calls. Mode A usually wins for low latency but requires hardened sidecar and attestation.
max-se: example sidecar config we'd test in POC:
```yaml
key_proxy:
  cache_ttl: 60s # how long unwrapped key lives in memory
  max_cached_keys: 8
  wrap_algo: AES-GCM-256
rotation:
  cron: "0 */4 * * *" # customer wants 4-hr rotation
  chaos_dryrun: false
```
sara-sales: billing note — if we hit >5k key unwraps/min you'll see incremental key-op charges; we'll map that in the quote. Also Dedicated capacity contract can bundle some of that for predictable pricing.
anita-security: auditors will need: HSM attestation report (customer CloudHSM or HSM vendor certs), CMEK proof-of-possession logs, and per-request audit trail (key-id, wrap/unwrap, principal). We can provide sample log schema.
bob-customer: can you show sample audit line? need to drop into our SIEM.
max-se: sample log (single-line JSON) — we will provide full schema in the SOW, but quick example:
```
{"ts":"2026-06-01T14:12:03Z","key_id":"proj-abc/kek-01","op":"unwrap","request_id":"r_1234","principal":"redwood-se-prod","src_ip":"10.2.3.4"}
```
sara-sales: POC plan proposal:
- Week 1: network & security kickoff (attestation, firewall rules, audit schema)
- Week 2: deploy sidecar + small throughput perf run (p50/p95) in staging
- Week 3: rotation stress (rotate every 4h for 48h), measure unwrap ops and cost delta
- Week 4: sign off & production cutover checklist

sara-sales: action items — @max-se to draft SOW & perf test plan, @anita-security to attach attestation certs and log schema, @bob-customer to confirm expected QPS and acceptable cost envelope.
deploy-bot: deploy-status: staging/key-proxy v0.8 rolled to cluster stg-2 at 2026-06-01T14:20:10Z :rocket:
max-se: noted — I'll push a perf script that simulates 12ms per-token target with/without KMS calls. Will also include a knob to toggle cache_ttl so we can quantify unwrap ops vs latency.
bob-customer: perfect — if POC shows cache_ttl=60s meets SLAs and audit needs are met, we can move forward. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
